constitutive_scope.control: c2 = 0 is used as a neo-Hookean control

claims.statement: With s=r sin(theta/2)^2, y2 = P r^(1/2) sin(theta/2) and y1-c0 = C_s s + P^(-1/2) r^(5/4) g(theta) + ...; the leading constraint does not determine C_s
The constraint is invariant under y1 -> y1+F(y2); C_s s is the first analytic Mode-I member and changes the physical horizontal coordinate
Regular-axis outer-branch selection gives g(0)=4 sqrt(2)/5 and g(pi)=2.033311...; full finite-compliance axis/matching selection remains open
J r^(1/4) = sqrt(P/2), independent of theta at leading order
G = (pi/2) c1 P^2, including arbitrary C_s in the retained constrained map
At lambda=1.6, c2/c1 = 1/3, 1, and 3 retain the energy balance, amplitude relation, angular flatness of J r^(1/4), and reported opening and near-axis in-plane finite-window exponents

For persistent nonzero C_s the raw face exponent is 1/2; 2/5 applies only when C_s=0 or conditionally to the residual after subtracting C_s r. The stored c2>0 annuli resolve a nonzero s-like background and raw slopes near 1/2, but do not establish a universal residual exponent
sigma22 r = G/pi at leading order; this relation is class-universal and is shared by the c2=0 control
A completed five-block finite-compliance spectrum and normalized extraction integrals are not established in this repository
